name: Unfaltering Siphon
description: Run a steady siphon from a hostile soul force into the user's reserve for as long as contact lasts.

name: Absorbent Veil
description: Wear a veil of soul force that soaks the first part of a mental blow.

name: Siphon Feel
description: Feel the pull of a siphon against a foe's soul to tell how strongly it resists.

name: Parched Pull
description: Pull the moisture of will from a target's soul until its resolve cracks and flakes.

name: Hungry Veil
description: Hold a veil that swallows part of a soul strike and throws the remainder back at the striker.

name: Erosion Siphon
description: Siphon the erosion left by a soul wound out of an ally's soul and burn it for plain force.

name: Siphoned Lash
description: Lash a target's soul with the force siphoned from its last attack.

name: Ravening Siphon
description: Open a wide siphon on all hostile force near the user and feed it to the reserve as a flood.

name: Greedy Tide
description: Draw on a target's soul so greedily that its force runs thin and its techniques fall away.

name: Flame Reading
description: Read the flame in a hostile technique and learn where it can be drawn.

name: Taken Flame
description: Take the flame of a hostile technique into the reserve and feed the user's own fire.

name: Smothering Cover
description: Smother the flame of a hostile blow under a cover of soul force before it spreads.

name: Spark Requital
description: Return a spark of drawn flame to the soul that threw it.

name: Banked Fire
description: Bank drawn flame deep in the soul and let it lift every later technique.

name: Flame Reversal
description: Reverse the flame of a hostile strike through the veil and throw it back.

name: Fire Given Back
description: Return the whole flame of a drawn strike through a soul's guard in one thrust.

name: Quenching Draw
description: Quench a burning curse in an ally's soul by drawing its heat into the user and spending it harmlessly.

name: Keen Gleaning
description: Cast a keen eye over a field of hostile force and mark the richest part for the draw.

name: Stoop Draw
description: Stoop on a hostile technique and seize its force in a single clean draw.

name: Feathered Cover
description: Fan a cover of soul force like feathers that soaks and spreads the force of a mental push.

name: Talon Snatch
description: Snatch the core of a target's gathering technique in a talon of soul force.

name: Swooping Slip
description: Swoop out of the line of a strike with its force already drawn into the user.

name: Rich Gleaning
description: Glean the richest hostile force over a wide span and carry it back to the reserve.

name: Wheeling Return
description: Wheel about and return drawn force to the soul of the foe that fed it.

name: Taloned Purge
description: Take a lingering soul curse in talons of soul force and tear it from an ally.

name: Patient Reaping
description: Hold a draw open above a long fight and reap force from every blow that falls near the user.

name: Falling Tithe
description: Drop the stored tithe of a whole fight as a heavy blow on every soul near the target.

name: Silt Reading
description: Read the silt in a hostile flow of force to see which part is worth drawing.

name: Settling Draw
description: Let drawn force settle in the basin of the soul until it clears and becomes the user's own.

name: Embankment
description: Raise an embankment of soul force that holds back a flood of hostile intent.

name: Weir Pull
description: Pull a target's force through a weir of soul force so it flows out slowly.

name: Reclaiming Flow
description: Turn a river of hostile force back into the reserve and clean it as it comes.

name: Silted Purge
description: Let a curse settle as silt and draw it out of an ally's soul.

name: Returning Surge
description: Send the reclaimed flow back in a wide surge over every soul that fed it.

name: Great Reclaiming
description: Draw back all the force a foe has spent in a long exchange and pour it into the reserve.

name: Torrent Lock
description: Dam a target's flow of force at its source so its techniques cannot be gathered.

name: Gale Taste
description: Taste the wind for the force a technique has left behind to see what can be taken.

name: Gust Intake
description: Take in the spent force that a gust of battle blows past the user.

name: Gust Soak
description: Soak a gust of hostile intent into the soul and breathe out only the dregs.

name: Cutting Return
description: Return spent force as a cutting gust against the soul that spent it.

name: Tempering Gale
description: Temper the drawn force in a steady gale of the soul until it is fit to fuel any technique.

name: Dregs Purge
description: Blow the dregs of a soul-wound out of an ally on a stream of drawn force.

name: Sworn Intake
description: Hold the draw steady through a storm of blows and store every share of force without letting any slip.

name: Gale Repayment
description: Return all stored force in a gale that strikes every soul in front of the user.

name: Open Gauge
description: Read how much room remains in the cistern when it stands open to the air.

name: Open Intake
description: Open the cistern to the air so it takes in the force of passing techniques.

name: Rain Cover
description: Let a cover of soul force catch a hostile blow like falling rain and carry it into the cistern.

name: Overhead Pull
description: Pull at a target's soul from above so its force drains upward into the cistern.

name: Brisk Slip
description: Slip briskly off the line of a blow as the cistern drinks its force.

name: Storm Filling
description: Fill the cistern fast in the middle of a battering storm of techniques.

name: Open Release
description: Open the cistern wide and loose its stored force on all nearby souls at once.

name: Drained Taint
description: Drain a binding or curse from an ally's soul into the open cistern.

name: Bottomless Cistern
description: Open the cistern so wide that it takes in every hostile force near the user without filling.

name: Draining Sky
description: Drain the force from every soul under the open reach of the user until their techniques falter.
